text: This project implements a Docker-based framework for comparing reactive, predictive, and error-aware adaptive predictive autoscaling. Locust sends controlled traffic through Nginx to healthy FastAPI replicas. The monitoring pipeline stores five-second CPU, memory, request-rate, response-time, and replica measurements in MongoDB. A Random Forest regression model predicts aggregate CPU 30 seconds ahead using only information available at the prediction time. The controller records prediction feedback and can retrain a candidate model after persistent errors, subject to chronological validation before activation.
